title: Reception (2nd type) — gaps -> answers, Romans 8:28-30
engine: RECEPTION (#4) — gap-centric twin of the who-received view
anti_fabrication: Every theologian->gap edge is tagged grounded or inferred. GROUNDED = the S156 Gloss run (commentary_constellation_result, run_tag cc20_rom8_s156) directly records this persona commenting on this gap; the edge 'fill' is trimmed from that DB payload. INFERRED = the theologian did NOT comment on this gap in the run; the edge is my reconstruction of how their documented position would answer it. Inferred edges are plausible, not asserted as fact.

grounding_key.gloss-seated: This persona was seated on the S156 crit-panel (cc20_rom8_s156) AND filed a comment on this exact gap. Edge is grounded; fill is real DB text.
grounding_key.attested: Well-attested historical reader of Romans 8 (from the who-received graph) whose answer to this gap is reconstructed from the documentary record. Edge is inferred.
grounding_key.gap-scan: The gap itself is a real row in source_move_gap for ROM-8-28-30 (the move-grammar gap scan).

answer_types.resolves: Supplies a determinate answer that CLOSES the gap on the theologian's own terms.
answer_types.reframes: Recasts the question so the gap changes shape or dissolves into a different reading (often the rival camp's move).
answer_types.deepens: Supplies interior / experiential texture that ENRICHES the gap without settling the doctrinal question — the native response to an 'interior' gap.
answer_types.refuses-to-close: Deliberately preserves the gap AS gap (aporia-preserving). In this run, represented by the panel's aporia-preserving MODE-fill on GAP-1f5087dd31, not by any single theologian; kept in the taxonomy for the render.

gap_scan_summary.note: 31 gaps found on ROM-8-28-30 by the move-grammar scan. 13 are filled-internally (closed by another move IN the text — those need no external answer). 18 are open/residual (no move in the text fills them — these are what a theologian answers from outside). This graph nodes the 3 that the crit-panel actually commented on (all grounded) + 3 further high-interest open gaps reached only by inference.

nodes.label: M5->M6: firstborn -> historical call
nodes.why_selected: under-commented; the M5->M6 edge is load-bearing — it seams eternal family-status to historical call.
nodes.question: Why does the Son's being FIRSTBORN (eternal family-status) entail a historical CALLING of the siblings? The jump from primogeniture to a temporal call is not spelled out.

nodes.label: M4 interior: what conformity FEELS like
nodes.why_selected: novelty; the felt texture of being-conformed was noticed only by participatory/practice frames the doctrinal majority skipped.
nodes.question: What does conformity-to-the-Son's-image feel like FROM INSIDE? The interior experience of being-conformed (M4 'predestined to be conformed') is unsaid.

nodes.label: M5 reciprocity: do the siblings answer back?
nodes.why_selected: under-commented; sibling reciprocity is load-bearing for relational ontology but missed by critics fixed on the decree-chain's downward direction.
nodes.question: Whether the many brethren ACKNOWLEDGE / relate back to the firstborn is unsaid. Is the family relation one-directional (decreed downward) or genuinely reciprocal?

nodes.label: M7 instrument: BY WHAT MEANS justified?
nodes.question: By what MEANS is justification effected (faith? Christ's work? infused grace?) — not stated in the chain. THE Reformation gap; reached here only by inference.

nodes.label: M1 warrant: on whose authority 'we know'?
nodes.question: On whose authority does 'we know' rest — the ground of the assurance is unnamed. The assurance-basis gap; reached here only by inference.

nodes.label: M2->M3 edge: leap to election
nodes.question: Why does the guarantee (all-things-work-for-good for lovers-of-God) rest on a prior divine FOREKNOWING of a set? The leap from providential synergy to election is unstated. Reached here only by inference.

nodes.label: Augustine
nodes.position: Foreknowledge = gratuitous election, not foreseen merit; even the will's turning is prevenient gift.

nodes.label: Luther
nodes.position: The chain read through sola fide: alien righteousness, the viva vox evangelii creating the brethren it names.

nodes.label: Calvin
nodes.position: Eternal unconditional election is the fountainhead; election is confirmed by the calling (III.24).

nodes.label: Arminius
nodes.work: Examination of Perkins; Declaration of Sentiments
nodes.position: Foreknowledge = prescience of foreseen faith; calling is resistible; the 'those' are foreseen believers as a class.

nodes.label: Athanasius
nodes.work: Orations against the Arians; De Incarnatione
nodes.position: Firstborn = the Word made flesh so many share His sonship; conformity = theosis, incorruption regained.

nodes.label: Anselm
nodes.position: Reads the chain through convenientia/satisfactio: God will not leave incomplete what He began in rational nature.

nodes.label: Aquinas
nodes.work: Super Epistolam ad Romanos (c.8 lect.6); ST I q.23
nodes.position: Predestination as the ratio of the ordering to grace+glory in the divine mind; harmonises election with real secondary causes.

nodes.label: Karl Barth
nodes.position: Christ is both electing God and elect human; election is God's Yes in Christ, not a fixed roster of individuals.

nodes.label: Origen
nodes.position: Foreknowledge is God's prescience of each soul's free response — the fountainhead of the foreseen-faith reading.

nodes.label: John Chrysostom
nodes.position: Reads foreknowledge non-deterministically: calling honours human willingness; predestination follows foreseen assent.

nodes.label: Pelagius
nodes.position: Foreknowledge attaches to those God foresaw would believe by free will; the chain rewards foreseen faith.

edges.fill: The eternal decree of family-status must issue in a temporal vocatio by which the predestined are gathered, else primogeniture would be sterile.
edges.note: gloss-seated; via vocatio congrua — the passage from aeterna praedestinatio to its historical execution.

edges.fill: The Firstborn was set as Head of a predestined family so that in time His siblings are gathered by effectual calling — election confirmed by the calling (III.24).
edges.note: gloss-seated; a Head without members joined in time is a fiction God's counsel cannot suffer.

edges.fill: Primogeniture is a naked fiction unless the historical call goes out; the call is the Word, and the Word creates the brethren it names.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the viva vox evangelii summoning sinners out of despair.

edges.fill: By convenientia the historical call is required — else the God-Man's superabundant satisfactio would be rendered in vain, and God would fail from His inceptum.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the call is the fitting means by which the merit reaches the kin.

edges.fill: The family is a class defined by faith, not a fixed roster; so the call must go out generally and truly to all, a resistible summons met by foreknown response.
edges.note: gloss-seated; recasts the 'set' — without a real call to real hearers, primogeniture collapses into the absolute decree Arminius discarded.

edges.fill: The Firstborn is the Word who first called creatures from nothing; His primogeniture necessarily REISSUES that creative call in history to draw the corrupted back.
edges.note: gloss-seated; recasts the call cosmologically — the same Voice that summoned man from non-existence now summons him to incorruption.

edges.fill: Felt as the transitus from delectatio peccati to delectatio iustitiae — the wretched 'Miser ego homo!' yielding to a delight in righteousness that grace itself infuses.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the interior is reordered, not self-supplied — a new sweetness received per gratiam.

edges.fill: A simul: hatred of self and love increasing together — being pulled from almost-despair into the assurance of safety by a Word not spoken by the priest but by Christ.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the whole-life poenitentiam agite, cross carried outwardly, conscience clinging to Christ inwardly.

edges.fill: The daily bearing of the cross joined to self-denial — mortification of the corrupt nature, sustained by the certainty of gratuitous justification: mortification WITHOUT despair.
edges.note: gloss-seated; a doubled interior — suffering that mirrors the Son's passion, steadied by imputed righteousness.

edges.fill: Felt as being sweetly persuaded — the will engaged, faith increasing, a real synergy the believer knows he could interrupt but does not: joy in yielding, sober fear of falling away.
edges.note: gloss-seated; conformity cannot feel like being carried irresistibly if grace is resistible.

edges.fill: Felt as being drawn back from the verge of non-existence into incorruption — the effaced image reviving, the pull toward nothingness ceasing, things human becoming divine.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the interior of theosis, already underway.

edges.fill: Felt as the rational nature at last attaining what it was made to love and choose — fruendo Deo beatus — the misery of wanting-against-will yielding to its proper beatitude.
edges.note: gloss-seated; convenientia experienced inwardly, the fitting close of the soul's own design.

edges.fill: The brethren acknowledge the firstborn not by autonomous assent but solely because grace has already moved the will — the answering-back is itself gift, not the merit that earns it.
edges.note: gloss-seated; leaving reciprocity as an independent human act would reintroduce the foreseen-merit reading Augustine abandoned.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is the Spirit's secret operation sealing the elect to Christ — a recognition that FLOWS from union, not a condition they supply toward it.
edges.note: gloss-seated; recognition is the Spirit's testimony to an accomplished fact, not the clasp that closes an open account.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is faith alone — the terrified conscience cast wholly upon Christ's alien righteousness; the brotherhood given in Christ constitutes the answering-back, not the reverse.
edges.note: gloss-seated; insert a human performance and the indulgence-seller walks straight in to fill the slot with a price.

edges.fill: A real act of the rational will oriented to the summum bonum — God does not begin in vain, so He makes the free movement possible through what the God-Man accomplished, without overriding the will.
edges.note: gloss-seated; a satisfaction rendered by necessity carries no honor — the acknowledgment must be free yet fitting-and-assured.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is the genuine uncoerced response of faith by which election is CONDITIONALLY confirmed — a real answering-back God foreknew but did not compel.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the reciprocity slot is precisely where the conditional hinge of election becomes visible — a family constituted by compulsion is no family.

edges.fill: Not a volitional act rendered upward but the ontological EVENT of participation — creatures drawn back into the Word's own being; the recognition IS the single movement of theosis.
edges.note: gloss-seated; reduce it to cognitive assent and the gap is only papered over — the firstborn became what we are so we might become what He is.

edges.fill: Predestination is the ratio in the divine mind ordering the elect to grace and glory; the temporal call is the real secondary cause through which that eternal ordering is executed.
edges.note: inferred from Super Rom c.8 lect.6 + ST I q.23; not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: The call goes out to all and honours human willingness; primogeniture entails a call precisely because the family is gathered by foreseen assent, not decree.
edges.note: inferred from Homilies on Romans (Hom. 15); not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: There is no jump to reconcile: the call is God's universal Yes in Christ the elect human; primogeniture and vocation are one Christological act, not two temporal stages.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: The siblings' acknowledgment is a genuine act of the created will AND wholly caused by God as first cause — real secondary causality means the response is truly theirs and truly grace.
edges.note: inferred from the concursus doctrine (ST I q.23); harmonises with Augustine while granting real reciprocity.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is the soul's own free response, which God merely foreknew; the family is reciprocal because the siblings genuinely turn back of themselves.
edges.note: inferred from Comm. in Romanos bk 7 — the foreseen-faith fountainhead.

edges.fill: The brethren acknowledge the firstborn by their own free will; the reciprocity is entirely real and unaided — the answering love is the sibling's native act.
edges.note: inferred from Expositio in Romanos — the free-will reading Augustine forms his election doctrine against; the polar opposite of Augustine's grounded edge on this gap.

edges.fill: The 'those' is not a roster whose reciprocity must be secured; in Christ the elect human, the answering-back is already given in Him and need not be an anxious human contribution.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; dissolves the roster question the whole panel argues over.

edges.fill: Justification is effected by faith alone laying hold of Christ's alien righteousness — the means is the Word-given promise received, nothing rendered by the sinner.
edges.note: inferred; Luther is gloss-seated on ROM8 but did NOT comment on this specific gap in the run.

edges.fill: By imputation through Spirit-wrought union with Christ — His penal satisfaction reckoned to the believer, applied by the Spirit's hidden work.
edges.note: inferred; Calvin is gloss-seated on ROM8 but did NOT comment on this specific gap in the run.

edges.fill: By grace INFUSED into the soul (gratia gratum faciens) that makes the sinner actually righteous — justification as a real transformation, not only a forensic declaration.
edges.note: inferred from ST I-II q.113; the Catholic infused-grace answer against which the Reformation gap is drawn.

edges.fill: The 'we know' rests on the immutable eternal decree; assurance is grounded in God's unchanging election, not in the believer's fluctuating introspection.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.24; not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: The guarantee rests on prior gratuitous election because the co-working good is not owed to the lovers' love but flows from the God who first named them — the leap IS the priority of grace.
edges.note: inferred; consistent with Augustine's grounded edges but not filed on this specific edge-gap in the run.

edges.fill: The 'set' foreknown is the class of foreseen believers, not an absolute decree; the guarantee rests on God's foreknowledge of faith, so the leap is to prescience, not election.
edges.note: inferred; consistent with Arminius's grounded reframes but not filed on this specific edge-gap in the run.
